C0496.title: Bank of Communications Depositor Li Hong Loses Nearly 430,000 Yuan to Fake Facial Recognition Theft
C0496.summary: In a case heard by the Beijing Fengtai District People's Court, plaintiff Li Hong was induced by fraudsters to download a malicious app and enable screen sharing, through which her facial video and bank card details were captured. The fraudsters used the fake facial video to bypass six facial recognition checks on the Bank of Communications app, stealing nearly 430,000 yuan from her account.

references.title: Banks unable to distinguish real from fake faces, frequent cases of depositor fund theft
